description:
Telephone Operator helps users make phone calls without manually typing phone numbers on their phone. Select or focus a phone number on the computer and use the NVDA shortcut to send the number to a phone connected to the same network. Verify the number on the phone and press CALL.

To start: Press NVDA+Alt+Z or Go to NVDA menu > Tools > Telephone Operator > Start Telephone Operator.
On your phone: Open the displayed address in your browser or scan the QR code shown in the dialog.
To send a number: Press NVDA+Alt+C after selecting or focusing the phone number.
The number will appear on your Phone. Verify number and Press Call button.
To stop: Press NVDA+Alt+Z or Go to NVDA menu > Tools > Telephone Operator > Stop Telephone Operator.
